t: Shankh is an urgent alert that rings on every screen until each person presses Seen. Admins send it.
In this video, you will learn how to sound the Shankh, choose who gets it, and follow who has seen it.
Press the shell button in the top bar.
Choose who: everyone, a department, or picked people.
Write the message, and pick the kind: outage, fire drill, client issue or alert.
Choose when to remind their managers if they have not seen it, and whether to also send an email.
Everyone gets a ringing alert they cannot miss. It stops when they press Seen.
You see a live board of who has seen it, can remind managers, and close the alert for everyone. Recent alerts lists the last ones.
That completes the Shankh alerts page.
Next in the Alerts & settings menu: Out of office and stand-in.
